findings.evidence: Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Algebra/MatrixExponential.lean:144,175 provides isUnit_exp and exp_neg; LinearAlgebra/Matrix/NonsingularInverse.lean:252,264 provides cancellation; LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Trace.lean:198 provides trace_units_conj'.
